params._token: contract address of the token we are depositing

depositFor(address,address,uint160).details: Enables the Flare FCE on-chain deposit path (see      infra/stacks/fcc/extension/contracts/AspensInstructionSender.sol): the relayer      holds the user's tokens transiently, approves this contract, and calls      `depositFor` so custody AND the credited tradeBalance both land here — keeping      `settleBatch`/`withdraw` unchanged — while the cosigned instruction names the      real depositor. Unlike `deposit`, tokens are pulled from `msg.sender` (the      relayer), not from `_account`; the credit + event are against `_account`. Same      fee-on-transfer-safe accounting as `_deposit`; `_deposit` itself is untouched.

params._amount: amount to pull from msg.sender (>= MIN_ORDER_SIZE)

params._account: beneficiary whose NATIVE tradeBalance is credited

multicall(bytes[]).details: Apply `delegatecall` with the current contract to each calldata in `data`, and store the `abi.encode` formatted results of each `delegatecall` into `results`. If any of the `delegatecall`s reverts, the entire context is reverted, and the error is bubbled up. By default, this function directly returns the results and terminates the call context. If you need to add before and after actions to the multicall, please override this function.

returns._owner: the instance owner / TEE signer address

setWithdrawEpochCap(address,uint256).details: Gated to the operator admin — the stack's own key, never the TEE      signer, because this cap exists to bound what a compromised TEE can      withdraw and the TEE must not be able to raise it. Rotate with      `setOperatorAdmin`.

settleBatch((address,address,int256)[],(.details: Off-chain shadow-ledger net settlement. In the optimistic      model funds are NOT locked per order; matched trades accumulate as net      deltas off-chain and are reflected on-chain here in a single batch.      Safety:      - signed by the instance owner (the TEE);      - per token, the contract computes        `fee = grossVolume*maintenanceBps/DENOMINATOR (floor) + grossVolume*operatorBps/DENOMINATOR (floor)`        and requires the trader deltas to sum to exactly `-fee` — the fee is the        conservation sink. Non-bypassable: under- OR over-paying the computed        fee reverts SETTLE_NOT_CONSERVED, so the on-chain bps is enforced        against the reported volume;      - the skim accrues to `maintenanceAccrued`/`operatorAccrued`, paid out        later (slower cadence) by `settleFees`;      - no account's `tradeBalance` may go negative (no overdraw / mint);      - one-shot per `_nonce` (replay-protected).

params._signature: owner EIP-712 signature over (deltasHash, volumesHash, nonce)
params._volumes: per-token gross matched volume (drives the fee computation)

params._token: token whose accrued fees to pay out

terminate().details: Gated to the owner (the TEE signer) OR the operator admin (the stack's      own, non-TEE key). The operator-admin path is the point: it releases the      funds even when the TEE / signer key is gone — the venue-teardown case,      in which a voucher can never be produced again. One-way: no un-terminate.

withdraw((address,address,uint256,uint25.details: In the optimistic shadow-ledger model a self-service withdrawal is      unsafe: on-chain `tradeBalance` still includes funds reserved behind      resting orders (reservations are off-chain), so a user could drain      collateral a later `settleBatch` is obligated to pay out. The TEE —      the authority on the withdrawable balance — signs a voucher instead;      the contract enforces only bounded backstops:      - signed by the instance owner (the TEE), like `settleBatch`;      - a non-zero amount (a zero voucher would only burn a nonce);      - not past `expiry`; one-shot per `(account, nonce)` (replay-proof);      - hard cap: never pays more of a token than `tradeBalance` holds (no mint);      - per-token per-epoch rate limit (TEE-bug blast-radius backstop).      Anyone may submit it (gas payer need not be the recipient): funds      always go to `_v.account`, so a relayer can pay gas for a gasless      withdrawal.

params._signature: owner EIP-712 signature over the voucher fields

withdrawTerminated(address).details: Deliberately NOT epoch-rate-limited: the cap bounds a LIVE compromised      TEE, but here there is no TEE and the caller withdraws only what the      contract already records as theirs, so applying the cap could only strand      funds — the opposite of recovery. Balance is zeroed before the transfer      (CEI; `nonReentrant` also guards), so a token can be reclaimed only once.

params._token: token address, or the `NATIVE` sentinel, to reclaim.

deposit(address,uint160).notice: Allows a user to deposit tokens into this contract.

depositFor(address,address,uint160).notice: Deposit on behalf of `_account`, pulling the tokens from the CALLER.

depositNative().notice: Deposit the chain's native asset (ETH/FLR), credited under the         NATIVE sentinel key. The native analogue of `deposit`.

depositNativeFor(address).notice: Native-asset analogue of `depositFor` (the Flare FCE relayer         path): the VALUE comes from the caller, while the credit + event         go to `_account`.

factory().notice: The factory that deployed this instance (immutable arg at byte 20).

maintenanceAddress().notice: Maintenance fee recipient — Aspens-controlled, immutable for this instance.

maintenanceBps().notice: Maintenance fee in basis points — Aspens-controlled, immutable for this instance.

operatorAdmin().notice: Effective operator admin: the storage override if rotated, else the baked-in         immutable arg (byte 62). Gates `setOperatorFee` / `setOperatorAdmin` /         `setWithdrawEpochCap`.

owner().notice: The instance owner — the TEE signer (immutable arg at byte 0).         Authorizes `settleBatch` and withdrawal vouchers.

setOperatorAdmin(address).notice: Rotate the operator admin (current operator admin only).

setOperatorFee(address,uint16).notice: Set or rotate the operator fee (stack admin only). Skimmed IN ADDITION to         the maintenance fee; the combined fee may not exceed DENOMINATOR (100%).         A zero `_bps` disables the operator fee.

setWithdrawEpochCap(address,uint256).notice: Set the per-epoch withdrawal cap for a token. `0` disables the cap         (unlimited). Caps bound the blast radius of a TEE bug; start         conservative and raise as confidence grows.

settleBatch((address,address,int256)[],(.notice: Apply a TEE-signed batch of net balance changes to `tradeBalance`,         skimming the maintenance + operator fees the contract computes from         the reported per-token gross matched volume.

settleFees(address).notice: Pay out the accrued maintenance + operator fees for a token to their         configured recipients' `tradeBalance` (from which they withdraw by         voucher). Intended to run on a slower cadence than `settleBatch`.         Permissionless — it only ever moves accrued fees to the on-chain         configured addresses.

terminate().notice: EMERGENCY: permanently terminate this instance. Sets `isTerminated`,         which makes every trade operation (deposits, `settleBatch`, voucher         `withdraw`) revert from here on, and opens `withdrawTerminated` so each         account can reclaim its on-chain `tradeBalance` WITHOUT a TEE voucher.

version().notice: Get current version of the contract

withdraw((address,address,uint256,uint25.notice: Withdraw tokens against a TEE-signed voucher.

withdrawTerminated(address).notice: After termination, reclaim the caller's entire on-chain `tradeBalance`         of `_token` to the caller. Permissionless — each account can only pull         its own recorded balance — and needs NO TEE signature, so it survives         loss of the signer key.
